name: Phoenix Client Presentation
tagline: The self-certification plugin, presented to the client that asked for it.

page.objective: Show a client how weekly Level-1 self-certification works, end to end, in one meeting.
page.problem: The value of an automated compliance check is hard to convey without seeing it run.
page.solution: A single-file deck backed by a standalone bundle — plugin, screenshots, standards and strategy in one folder with no external paths.
